items.name: Saber of Chelish Authority
items.description:
The Saber of Chelish Authority is issued to naval lieutenants and captains whose performance and loyalty have been deemed exemplary. Though clearly ostentatious with its gilded basket hilt, engraved devil-wing motifs, and lacquered red-black steel blade, its material value is modest. The real worth lies in its deadly craftsmanship and the subtle enchantments laced into the steel by naval artificers of House Thrune.
It is a +1 saber (use stats for a scimitar) designed for fluid combat and visual

items.name: Chain Shirt MW
items.description: Covering the torso, this shirt is made up of thousands of interlocking metal rings.

items.name: Sea-Service Pistol
items.description: This masterfully crafted flintlock-style pistol, issued exclusively to officers of the Chelish Navy, represents the height of their martial craftsmanship. The weapon's stock is made from lacquered darkheart rosewood and inlaid with infernal gold filigree, its grip engraved with the winged crown of House Thrune. Despite appearing archaic to Alkenstar engineers or Technic League scholars, it is a weapon of status, discipline, and deadly precision in Cheliax.
